## Highlights

TigerMarkView 0.10.0 moves to a new installer and makes the application easier
to reach from Explorer. The viewer, PDF export, and the `tiger-mark` command
behave as in 0.9.0, including all of its active-content protections.

- **A new installer, built with TigerSetup.** It still installs the desktop
  application and `tiger-mark` together, per user by default or for all users,
  with the same install folders, the **PATH** option on by default, and an
  optional desktop shortcut.
- **Open with for Markdown.** TigerMarkView is registered as an available app
  for `.md` and `.markdown` files, so it appears under **Open with** and in
  **Settings > Apps > Default apps**. The installer never makes itself the
  default and never replaces an app you have chosen. If you have never chosen
  one, Windows may open Markdown files with TigerMarkView directly.
- **Missing runtimes are installed for you.** When the .NET 10 Desktop Runtime
  or the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime is missing, the installer now downloads
  it from Microsoft and installs it before TigerMarkView, asking for
  administrator approval where the runtime needs it.

## Fixed

- A document dropped on the document area of the window is now recorded in
  **File > Open Recent**, like a document dropped on the menu bar, toolbar, or
  status bar. Links you follow still go only to the navigation history.

## Upgrading from 0.9.0 or earlier

- Installing 0.10.0 removes an earlier TigerMarkView installation in the same
  scope first, then installs the new one. Your settings, recent files, and PDF
  export choices are kept.
- The earlier installation is found only in the scope you install into. If
  0.9.0 was installed for all users, install 0.10.0 for all users too (the
  all-users choice in the wizard, or `--scope machine`). A per-user install
  leaves an all-users 0.9.0 in place; remove it from **Settings > Apps** if you
  do not want both.
- **Unattended installs use new switches.** The Inno Setup options such as
  `/VERYSILENT` and `/CURRENTUSER` no longer apply. Use, for example,
  `TigerMarkView-0.10.0-win-x64-setup.exe install --quiet` for the current
  user, `install --quiet --scope machine` for all users, and
  `--option path off` to leave PATH unchanged. A quiet per-user install stops
  with an error rather than prompting when a missing runtime needs
  administrator approval.
- TigerMarkView now has a new entry in **Settings > Apps**, and uninstalling
  removes only what it installed: its files, shortcuts, its own PATH entry, and
  the Markdown registration. Settings and any default app you chose are left
  alone.

## Prerequisites and known limitations

- Windows 10 version 1809 or later, or Windows 11, x64.
- .NET Desktop Runtime 10 and the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime. They are not
  bundled; the installer checks for both and installs a missing one from
  Microsoft.
- This build is unsigned. Windows SmartScreen may warn on first run; the
  published `SHA256SUMS.txt` lets you confirm the download.
- TigerMarkView is not yet available through WinGet. The package
  `ItTiger.TigerMarkView` will be submitted to the community repository after
  this release; until it is accepted, install from the asset below.

## Install

Download and run `TigerMarkView-0.10.0-win-x64-setup.exe` from the assets below.
Per-user installation is the default and needs no elevation.
